clues.text: Fleeing Sodom, Lot's wife looked back and became one made of salt.
As Israel left Egypt, the LORD went before them as one of cloud by day and fire by night.
In the Philistine temple, Samson braced his hands against the two central ones and pushed until the temple fell.
At Bethel, Jacob set up the stone he had slept on as one and poured oil on top.
At the portico of his temple, Solomon set up two of them, naming them Jachin and Boaz.
Having no son to carry his name, Absalom set one up for himself in the King's Valley.
In a letter to a church, the Lord promises to make the one who overcomes one of these in God's temple.
